symptoms: press refuses to cycle; light curtain keeps faulting; 07 alarm
root_cause: light curtain misaligned and lens dirty
steps: lock out the machine; clean the emitter and receiver lenses; realign the light curtain using the alignment indicators; run the safety function test and record it; get supervisor sign-off before returning to production

symptoms: product pushed off the edge; belt drifts to one side
root_cause: build-up on an idler roller pushing the belt off line
steps: stop and lock out the conveyor; find the idler with build-up; clean the roller surface and check it spins freely; square the roller to the frame
